locations.note: In 1514 the inventor Feodor Morales escapes the Inquisition, which seizes his brother Ramon, by balloon.
The balloon comes down on a church spire in Almería, where Feodor meets Jamila and is carried off by corsairs.
Among the corsairs of Malta, Feodor must win five captains to his side and pass a diving test.
Sold as a slave into the palace at Tripoli, Feodor frees Ramon and the Emir from its prison.
Across the desert, past a mountain monastery held by the Inquisitor, Feodor opens the gate of the white city and restores its healing fountain.
